# Generated by mods/cm_maps/tools/port_from_cm.py - do not edit by hand.
# Lifted from Construction Manager dev, cm_proximity_finder_scripted_gui.txt.
# Renamed cm_ -> bcm_ and nothing else; rebuild after a CM update.

# Placement finder controllers. Root is the player country for all.
bcm_pf_prep_gov = {
	effect = {
		# Flags the finder mode open for the action bar refresh button (bcm_pf_refresh) is_shown.
		set_variable = { name = bcm_pf_mode_open value = 1 }
		# The viewed mode; the run computes only this one.
		set_variable = { name = bcm_pf_view_g value = 1 }
		remove_variable = bcm_pf_view_c
		bcm_pf_prep_gated = yes
	}
}

bcm_pf_run_batch = {
	effect = {
		bcm_pf_run_batch_all = yes
	}
}

# Gates the tick drivers on the same pair bcm_pf_run_batch_all's own entry gate reads. bcm_pf_prep_core
# removes bcm_pf_all_done as it primes, so priming is what re-arms a driver that has gone idle.
bcm_pf_batch_ready = {
	is_shown = {
		has_variable = bcm_pf_n
		NOT = { has_variable = bcm_pf_all_done }
	}
}

# is_shown gates the repaint driver; Execute clears the flag after the repaint fires.
bcm_pf_repaint_ready = {
	is_shown = {
		exists = var:bcm_pf_repaint
	}
	effect = {
		remove_variable = bcm_pf_repaint
	}
}

# Action bar refresh button, shown while a finder mapmode is open (bcm_pf_mode_open, set in
# bcm_pf_prep on open and cleared by bcm_pf_clear_mode_open on close).
bcm_pf_refresh = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = {
		exists = var:bcm_pf_mode_open
	}
}

# Clears the finder-mode-open and viewed-mode flags, plus any abandoned run's transients; fired by
# the mapmode window when the last finder mode closes.
bcm_pf_clear_mode_open = {
	effect = {
		remove_variable = bcm_pf_mode_open
		remove_variable = bcm_pf_view_g
		remove_variable = bcm_pf_view_c
		# Closing the mode stops the driver that would have reached bcm_pf_finalize, so this run's
		# per-location transients and bcm_pf_en / bcm_pf_ev maps would otherwise sit in the save until
		# some later run's prep happened to clear them.
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = bcm_pf_n
				NOT = { has_variable = bcm_pf_all_done }
			}
			bcm_pf_clear_run_state = yes
		}
	}
}
